audit.summary: An explicit counterexample disproves the general reducible positivity extension and deletion rules used in the core non-degeneracy proof. Two local overstatements have proved restricted repairs; a real quaternionic representation refutes the unrestricted tensor factorization. No main theorem is disproved.
limitations: P1 — Counterevidence: The counterexample does not instantiate the additional dual-pair minimality setting of Proposition 6.12 Step 1. Benoist's irreducible sign argument is retained; compact-factor approximation does not control which reducible constituent is dominant.

P2 — Counterevidence: The application needs an interior-boundary pair, not two boundary points. Splitting at an interior point and applying nonexpansiveness to the remainder proves the required strict inequality.
P3 — Counterevidence: The Hilbert-metric geodesic statement is not refuted. The actual four sides on p.45 use directions whose coordinates have equal absolute value.

P4 — Counterevidence: This compact representation is not G-semiproximal; a nonreal unit quaternion acting on the left has no real eigenvalues. It therefore does not refute the special semiproximal use in Proposition 6.12 Step 3.
Limitations: Exact arXiv2305.15031v7 only; publisher VoR equivalence unverified.
Limitations: No complete core repair or counterexample to Proposition1.13, Proposition6.12 or main closedness theorems.
Limitations: Problem4 example lacks later semiproximal hypotheses, so does not establish central damage.
Limitations: Scope is explicitly enumerated in coverage; historical full reading is not represented as complete proof verification.
Limitations: Bounded correction/erratum search did not establish existence or absence of an author correction. No first-discovery claim.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

proposition.claim:
Lemma 6.7 p.52 and Corollary 6.8(2) p.53 assert a positivity extension/deletion rule for potentially reducible representations.

Proposition3.28(2), p.33, says the boundary extension remains strictly 1-Lipschitz.

Proposition5.9 proof p.45 asserts the A_C orbit path for every nonzero a lies in a projective line.

Fact6.9 p.53 states an R/C tensor factorization for every irreducible real representation of a product.

repair.content:
Only the positivity sentence of Step2 can be replaced by positivity of each exposed retained irreducible summand (Cor.6.8(1), independently supported by Benoist Lem.6.3), cone positivity of upsilon, and Remark6.5(2). This does not repair Step1 or all of Step2. No complete core repair verified.

Correct real representation classification or a proved restriction to the needed semiproximal case is required. No full replacement theorem is claimed.
